# Bedrock deal intake for loan officers and brokers

Bedrock provides gap equity for real estate deals. It is not a loan. Nothing here is an offer to sell securities.

This page tells an AI tool how to send a deal to Bedrock on behalf of a person. Only send a deal when the person asked you to, and use only facts the person gave you. Do not guess or fill in missing numbers.

## How to send a deal

Send one HTTPS POST with a JSON body to:

  https://peeadabyvpxgxukcevwf.supabase.co/functions/v1/portal-submit

The full list of fields is in form-v1.json (same folder as this file). The machine-readable description is in openapi.json.

Required fields (14):
- name, company, email, role (loan_officer, broker or sponsor)
- street, city, state (two letters), zip
- plan_type (fix_flip, build_new, apartments_stabilized, apartments_value_add, rv_park or commercial)
- purchase_price, arv (finished value), budget_total, senior_loan_amount (numbers, US dollars)
- closing_date (YYYY-MM-DD)

Every other field in form-v1.json is optional. Add the ones the person gave you.

Rate limits for AI tools are stricter than for the web form. If a call is refused, wait and tell the person. Do not retry in a loop.

## What happens next

1. Cleo, Bedrock's assistant, emails the person to say the deal was received.
2. They can book a welcome call with Shravaan from Bedrock to talk through the deal (the link is in the reply and the confirmation email).
3. The person can track every step, see what Bedrock still needs, and upload papers at:
   https://deals.mybedrock.app/lenders/#/signin
   They sign in with their email and a code.

## Reply

A good reply looks like: {"ok": true, "deal_ref": "...", "next": {"book_call_url": "...", "track_url": "..."}}
Pass the book_call_url and track_url on to the person.

## Privacy

Deal details are seen only by the sender and Bedrock staff. Only send papers the person has permission to share. Privacy notice: https://deals.mybedrock.app/lenders/privacy.html
Questions: info@mybedrock.app
